title: Kiosk Empathy Field Test
oneLiner: A field kit for Korean shops to test whether seniors and disabled customers can actually complete kiosk orders before complaints or mandates land.
theme: 건강 / 외로움 / 자산 방어 - accessibility, senior dignity, shop compliance cost, and in-store embarrassment.
stitchPrompt: Build a tablet-friendly field operations web app prototype called "Kiosk Empathy Field Test" for Korean cafes and franchise shops testing whether seniors and disabled customers can actually complete kiosk orders. The first screen must be a working field kit with a field-test session header, task script cards, pain-point logger, staff-assist lane, retrofit decision board, complaint-risk and mandate checklist, and before/after field report. Use realistic sample data: Seoul cafe kiosk, older customer feeling rushed, wheelchair height issue, missing tactile control, voice guidance absent, staff-assist alternative, vendor retrofit quote, and photos of problem steps. Design direction: use the field-ops profile with slate/steel service-operations styling, large field-safe controls, restrained cyan action accents, and reliable checklists designed for use on a tablet inside a busy shop. Do not make a marketing landing page; the first screen must be the working app.
